opportunities.title: Main Grants (Research, Development and Analysis Fund)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must be UK-based organisations with formal employment or contractual relationship to host institution; individuals and unaffiliated organisations are not eligible. Projects should address one or more of the Foundation's priority questions.
opportunities.summary: Offers up to £500,000 for research addressing priority questions outlined in the Strategic Review, aiming to improve lives in the UK.

opportunities.title: Racial Diversity UK Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Encourages applications from diverse backgrounds, especially racially minoritised communities, and partnership proposals involving researchers and community partners.
opportunities.summary: Supports research on racial diversity within the UK, aiming to understand barriers and pathways to a racially just and inclusive society.
